objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-powershell-add-module-to-global-assembly-cache
objects.description: The following analytic detects the addition of a DLL to the Windows Global Assembly Cache (GAC) using PowerShell. It leverages PowerShell Script Block Logging to identify commands containing "system.enterpriseservices.internal.publish". This activity is significant because adding a DLL to the GAC allows it to be shared across multiple applications, potentially enabling an adversary to execute malicious code system-wide.
